# ankra_slack_channels (Data Source)

Lists the channels the Ankra bot can post to in the organisation's connected Slack workspace, for the `channel_id` and `channel_name` of a Slack `ankra_alert_destination`. Fails when no Slack workspace is connected, or when the Slack connection lacks the permission to list channels (reconnect it in the portal).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_slack_channels" "workspace" {}

locals {
  slack_alerts_channel = one([for channel in data.ankra_slack_channels.workspace.channels : channel if channel.name == "alerts"])
}

resource "ankra_alert_destination" "slack_alerts" {
  name         = "slack-alerts"
  channel_id   = local.slack_alerts_channel.id
  channel_name = local.slack_alerts_channel.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) Channels the bot can post to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `team_id` (String) Slack workspace id.
- `team_name` (String) Slack workspace name.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Slack channel id, the destination's `channel_id`.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the channel is private.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
